label: id
comment: The globally unique ID of the product as a URI. Ideally as a resolvable URL according to ISO 18975.
A unique identifier for the declaration. Often this will be an extension of the product.id or attestation.id. But could be a UUID.

domainIncludes.comment: The ProductInformation class encapsulates detailed information regarding a specific product, including its identification details, manufacturer, and other pertinent details.
A declaration of conformance with one or more criteria from a specific standard or regulation.
